name: Flat Finder
description: It scans new flat listings every 15 minutes across Porto, Bari and Łódź, plus a morning digest at 08:00, looking for small 1-2 bedroom flats that rent well to locals and are priced fairly for their area. It only flags homes that look like solid rental investments and steers you away from ones needing big repairs. It always asks you on Telegram before doing anything, and it never makes an offer, pays, signs or sends a message without your approval.

The n8n workflow and 5 Apify actors
The rules R1 to R7, with the budget left for them to set
